solver_notes: Native C11/pthreads scheduler regression model executed on physical aarch64; this is not a claimed Tokio patch. Four workers each poll a depth-4 nested unyielding local future for 4096 scheduler ticks. The legacy path never decrements cooperative budget and never checks the shared global queue: 256 global tasks starve at zero completions. The fixed path decrements a 32-bit per-worker budget on every local poll, checks the global queue at tick 64 boundaries and on budget exhaustion, and resets an exhausted budget to 128. An atomic global task index provides real cross-worker distribution. Across five repeat runs plus UBSan, fixed execution completes all 256 global tasks with exact payload checksum while retaining all 16384 local ticks and 65536 nested polls. Scope is the cooperative/global-fallback scheduler model; no claim of upstream Tokio validation is made.
